---
title: "Stage 5 – Your own project"
---
In this stage you ask a question beyond the claim that SCORE selected from the paper, one that the data of the case study support. The [list below](#the-projects) gives the projects that the case study supports and where to start. As in the case-study report, the preregistration of the project is complete before anything in it runs. It is also fixed with a date that someone else can check, either as the first commit of the repository of the project, pushed to GitHub, or as a registration on OSF Registries. The stage takes about six and a quarter hours of work, and is best spread over several sittings.

## 1. Version control

[Open Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-why){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work through the module on git and GitHub for reproducible research, from [Version control](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-why) to [GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-github).

## 2. The preregistration of the project

[Open the preregistration templates](../../companion/repositories.qmd#sec-prereg-templates){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The section on registrations describes two templates, the AsPredicted form and the template for secondary data. Write the preregistration of your project with one of them, with a data-in-hand statement that says what you have already looked at in the data. Make it the first commit of a new repository and push it to GitHub, or register it on OSF Registries, before you run anything.

## 3. What to track

[Open What to track](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-repro){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read [What to track](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-repro) and [Your own reanalysis](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-application). Add your case-study report to the repository, with the workspace that renders it.

## 4. Your project

**In the repository of your project.** Run the specification that you declared, and that one first. Report its result as your preregistration said you would, and place it beside the curve of the case study where it can be placed. Label anything that you add after seeing the result as exploratory, and commit as you go.

## 5. Depositing the project

[Open Depositing a reanalysis](../../companion/repositories.qmd#sec-deposit){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The section sets out a route for depositing a reanalysis of your own. Write the README of your repository by it.

## 6. Publishing (optional)

[Open Quarto projects](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-project){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

Read [Projects](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-project) and [Publishing the document](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-publish) in the module on Quarto on the AR4DS website. Render your case-study report and the project together as one Quarto project, and publish the rendered output where other people can reach it.

**Shortcuts.** If you already use git and GitHub, skip the first step and read [What to track](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-repro) for what a licence can keep out of a repository.

## The projects {#the-projects}

Each item names a direction that the data and the pages of the case study support. The question, the specification and the rule by which the result is judged are yours to declare.

- **Another outcome or the Black names.** You can take another outcome of the paper, whether officials replied at all or replied within 24 hours, or compare the Black names with the white names, and all of these are in `housing_emails.csv`. Start from [Other outcomes and the Black names](../../curve.qmd#outcomes) on the Specification curve page.
- **A subgroup.** You can take the male or the female names alone, or the officials with Hispanic names, which makes a question about representative bureaucracy asked of a group selected after the emails arrived. Start from [Subgroups](../../curve.qmd#subgroups) on the Specification curve page and [Who replied](../../menu.qmd#who-replied) on the specification menu.
- **A replication on new data.** You can analyse the preregistered experiment on 3,050 housing authorities that the SCORE replicability study ran, whose de-identified data, do-file and dictionary are public, with the decisions of the menu. Start from [the replication](../../background.qmd#sec-replication) on the background page, and from the data at [osf.io/xseqg](https://osf.io/xseqg/).
